verdict: Ads paused 16 days; overdue setup items are the priority to resolve.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Meta delivered all 54 leads at a cost of $16.73 per lead before spend was paused on September 17 — the final 16 days of the period ran dark, with zero spend and zero new leads. Google Ads spent $233.57 in the same window and recorded no conversions, with nearly all of that budget in a single campaign that returned nothing attributable. Five setup milestones — including payment path verification, conversion tracking, and landing pages — were due by September 30 and remain unresolved; these are the direct blockers to restarting and scaling. Campaigns are being reactivated this week as those items clear, and October's target is to have both Meta and Google optimizing to real downstream results.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta, at $16.73 each
consecutive days with ads paused, from September 17 through today
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions attributed

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $233.57 this period with no leads to show for it.
watch_item.fix: Offline conversion tracking is being connected this week so Google can see and optimize toward real results — spend will be reassessed once attribution is live.
